subject: Human-Descendant AI Civilization Theory Vol. 8 — Epistemic Integrity, Evidence Lineage and Hostile-Information Resilience

canonical_parent.title: 人類子孫型AI文明論・第8論｜認識基盤・証拠系譜・敵対的情報耐性論⸻正しいKernelが偽情報によって誤作動する閉路を切る

problem_cluster: evidence lineage, independent confirmation, correlated repetition, uncertainty, memory/world-model correction, hostile or stale information
minimal_tests: trace apparently multiple sources to upstream evidence roots before counting independent confirmations
preserve whether a statement is observed, inferred, summarized, quoted, or independently reproduced
keep UNKNOWN distinct from TRUE and FALSE
after a material source correction, verify that derived memory and later judgments change rather than only the displayed text
do not use a system's own belief-driven effects as independent evidence for the original belief
audit false rejection as well as false acceptance in information defenses
falsification_and_non_fit: show that lineage retention does not materially improve error detection under the tested contract
show that separating correlated repetition from independent confirmation adds no decision value in the tested context
show that explicit evidence-quality/confidence separation consistently worsens decisions under reasonable conditions
show that correction of memory/world-model state has no meaningful downstream effect in the tested system
show that tracing cost systematically exceeds corrective benefit and identify the narrower useful boundary
interpretation_boundaries: This card is a discovery aid and does not replace the canonical Parent.
Traceability is not proof that a claim is true, and missing provenance is not proof that it is false.
The source does not require infinite tracing, universal skepticism, low confidence, or permanent indecision.
Hostile-information failure classes are for defensive/audit analysis, not instructions for manipulation or proof of an adversary's intent.
Independent reuse, counterexamples and non-fit results are stronger evidence than publication or linkage alone.
